Composition. The Presidential Executive Task Force for Relief and
Rehabilitation of Central Mindanao shall be composed of a Chairperson, two (2) Vice
Chairpersons, the initially constituted Sub-Task Force Chairpersons, and members of the
Sub-Task Forces. Other Sub-Task Forces may be constituted subsequently as required.
Constituted Sub-Task Forces may be disbanded by the Chail-person in consultation withthe
Chairpersons and Sub-Task Force Chairpersons, when need no longer exists.

Secretariat and Administrative SUIJIJort. Sub-Task Force Chairpersons
